narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Seven tenths and six tenths make thirteen twentieths.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>But the parts are still tenths, so we only count how many there are.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Thirteen parts, each of size one tenth, are thirteen tenths and nothing else.
removed_beats.on_screen: the slip's bubble shows 7/10 + 6/10 = 13/20; the tenth parts keep their size while they are counted; the slip is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Add units with units and tenths with tenths. Ten tenths make one more unit.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Your turn. Add one and eight tenths and two and five tenths.
